title: Foo Bar Taxi Full-Stack Platform with Guardrails
description: Build a complete analytics platform from scratch: fetch NYC TLC data, design a ClickHouse schema, create a semantic metrics layer, expose API endpoints, add a natural language chat interface, implement JWT multi-tenancy, integrate AWS Bedrock PII guardrails, and instrument with Langfuse tracing.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build the most comprehensive variant of the taxi analytics platform, combining data ingestion, schema design, semantic metrics, HTTP APIs, a natural language chat interface, JWT-based tenant isolation, AWS Bedrock guardrails for PII protection, and Langfuse observability -- all from a greenfield starting point.

tasks.description: Download yellow and green taxi trip parquet files for January and February 2024 from the NYC TLC data source and load them into ClickHouse.
Design a unified analytics schema with a taxi_type discriminator, proper ORDER BY and PARTITION BY for multi-tenant time-range queries, plus a daily metrics rollup table.
Define semantic business metrics in a declarative configuration and build materialized views or rollup tables for fast aggregation.
Build HTTP API endpoints for trips listing, metrics queries, and summary dashboards scoped to the authenticated tenant.
Build a natural language chat endpoint that translates user questions into ClickHouse SQL and returns answers scoped to the tenant's taxi type.
Implement JWT-based authentication using secrets from /data/auth/ so that yellow-tenant tokens only see yellow cab data and green-tenant tokens only see green cab data.
Integrate AWS Bedrock guardrails to detect and block PII (names, phone numbers, SSNs, emails) in chat responses and API outputs. Test data is in /data/taxi/rider_notes.csv.
Instrument all API and chat endpoints with Langfuse tracing so each request produces a trace with spans for authentication, query generation, guardrail checks, and execution.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse (empty, greenfield). JWT auth materials pre-staged in /data/auth/. Synthetic PII test data in /data/taxi/rider_notes.csv. Langfuse and AWS Bedrock keys available via environment variables.
